Which shortwave stations broadcast in Arabic?

In the A-26 schedule, 21 stations broadcast in Arabic. The most heavily scheduled include Radio Romania International, IRIB Voice of I.Radio Iran, Bible Voice, China Radio International.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts in Arabic?

The most-used frequencies are 15130, 15240, 15595, 9490, 9890 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
